pages.title: About
pages.body_html:
Slow Wave started with a fairly ordinary problem: knowing exactly what you should be doing before bed, and doing none of it.

The sleep market is full of gadgets that track how badly you slept and then tell you about it in the morning. That was never the missing piece. The missing piece is the twenty minutes beforehand — the part nobody sells, because it isn't a product.

So we made the objects for it, and wrote down the order they go in.

How we think about this

Four products. Not forty. Each one is the version we couldn't find when we went looking — a mask that actually seals at the nose, an eye pillow heavy enough to notice, a guide with no app attached.

We don't claim any of it will fix anything. We're not doctors and we're not going to pretend otherwise. What we'll say is that a better-set-up room and a routine you can stick to make the end of the day feel different, and that's worth something.

Where we are

Based in New Zealand. Orders ship from here, and the print-on-demand pieces are made here too — which is why they arrive in days rather than the month you'd wait on something shipped from overseas.

Questions, problems, or something arrived wrong? Get in touch — a real person reads it.

pages.title: Shipping
pages.body_html:
New Zealand

  • Standard — 2–4 working days, $6
  • Rural — 4–7 working days, $10
  • Free shipping on orders over $100

Australia

  • Standard — 6–12 working days, $14
  • Free shipping on orders over $150

Digital products

The Slow Wave Protocol is delivered by email as soon as your payment clears — usually within a minute or two. Nothing ships, and there's no shipping charge. If it hasn't arrived within an hour, check your spam folder, then email us and we'll send it again.

Dispatch

Orders placed before 2pm on a working day are packed and dispatched the same day. Orders after that, or on weekends and public holidays, go out the next working day.

Print-on-demand items (The Pillowcase) are made to order in New Zealand. Add 2–3 working days for production before the shipping times above.

Tracking

You'll get a tracking number by email when your order is dispatched.

If something goes wrong

The delivery estimates above are genuine estimates based on our courier's service, not marketing numbers — but couriers do occasionally run late and we don't control that. If your order is significantly overdue, tell us and we'll chase it or replace it.

pages.title: Returns & Refunds
pages.body_html:
The short version

30 days. If it's unused and in its packaging, send it back for a full refund. If it's faulty, you're covered regardless of how long you've had it — that's the law, and we're not going to argue with you about it.

Change of mind

Within 30 days of delivery, unused and in original packaging: full refund of the product price. Return postage is on you unless the item was faulty or we sent the wrong thing.

For hygiene reasons we can't accept a sleep mask or eye pillow back once it's been worn or used. This isn't us being difficult — it goes against the face.

Faulty or not as described

Send us a photo and we'll sort it: repair, replacement or refund, your choice on a major failure. We cover return postage. This applies well beyond 30 days — goods are expected to last a reasonable time.

Digital products

Because The Slow Wave Protocol is delivered instantly and can't be returned, we offer refunds on it only where the file hasn't been downloaded. If the download failed, or it isn't what the page described, email us and we'll refund it — downloaded or not.

Your legal rights

New Zealand: our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993. You're entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure, and to have goods repaired or replaced if they fail to be of acceptable quality.

Australia: our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. You're entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure and to compensation for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage.

Nothing on this page limits those rights.

How to start a return

Email us with your order number and what's wrong. We'll reply within one working day with the return address and next steps. Refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5 working days of the item arriving back.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.body_html:
Will this help me sleep?

We genuinely can't promise that, and we'd be suspicious of anyone who does. What we can tell you is what the products do: the mask blocks all the light, the eye pillow weighs 280g, and the guide walks you through setting up a room and a routine. Whether that changes your nights is down to you and your circumstances. If you've got an ongoing problem with sleep, talk to your doctor — we're a shop, not a clinic.

Is the guide just recycled internet advice?

It's 34 pages on sleep environment and wind-down routine, written plainly, with two printable checklists. If you've read a lot on this already you'll recognise some of it. What it gives you is the whole thing in one ordered place rather than forty browser tabs.

Why silk?

It's cool against the skin and doesn't drag at the corners of your eyes when you turn over. Cotton masks bunch. That's the practical reason — not a health claim.

Can I wear the eye pillow all night?

We wouldn't. It's designed for ten or twenty minutes at the end of the day, not eight hours. Use the mask overnight.

Do you ship to Australia?

Yes — 6–12 working days, free over $150. See Shipping.

Is the packaging recyclable?

Yes. Cardboard mailer, paper tape, no plastic film.

Can I buy the guide on its own?

Yes, it's $29 and arrives by email immediately. It's also included in The Ritual set, which works out cheaper if you want the objects too.

Something arrived damaged.

Send a photo to us and we'll replace it. You don't need to send the damaged one back.
